newsitem.title: BARBADOS: CRICKET-WEST INDIES REACH 68 FOR TWO AT LUNCH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WEST INDIES REACH 68 FOR TWO AT LUNCH.

text.p: Indian pace bowlers Venkatesh Prasad and Doda Ganesh struck early but West Indies recovered to reach 68 for two at lunch on the opening day of the third test on Thursday.
At the break Brian Lara, captaining West Indies for the first time in the absence of Courtney Walsh, was 11 not out and Shivnarine Chanderpaul was unbeaten on 20.

Prasad, taking early advantage of Sachin Tendulkar's decision to field first, removed opener Sherwin Campbell for six in the third over of the day. A lifting delivery produced a tentative forward push and a sharp catch to Mohammad Azharuddin at second slip.
Ganesh replaced Prasad in the attack and immediately accounted for Stuart Williams who had hit his maiden test hundred in the second test in Trinidad.
Williams had survived a difficult chance on 12 but fell on 24 to a catch at second slip by V.V.S.Laxman as he chased a wide ball outside off stump.
With Walsh ruled out because of a nagging hamstring injury, Trinidadian pace bowler Ian Bishop returned to the team following injury.
The first two tests ended in draws.
